summary: The NFTA is the project sponsor and transit authority responsible for developing and implementing the Metro Corridor rapid transit system in Buffalo. Throughout the document window, NFTA is described in its institutional role as the regional transit authority, including its bus operations, financial performance, and planning activities for the new rail transit line. No complaints or objections by NFTA are present in this window; rather, NFTA is consistently portrayed as the proponent driving the project forward.

mentions.quote: The NFTA is preparing the Niagara Frontier Elderly and Handicapped Study.

The NFTA has designated two areas that it owns as potential spoil disposal areas.
The NFTA will coordinate with City traffic personnel to select routes that will minimize problems with neighborhood air quality, noise, traffic, and roadway damage.

The NFTA will continue to coordinate closely with the City's Commissioner of Transportation and the NFTC during the General Engineering and Architectural Phase to discuss means of best meeting the traffic needs of this area.
The NFTA will continue working closely with City transportation planners to resolve these issues.
